fichas.title: Track spacing in public-road traffic spaces
fichas.summary: Diagrams show minimum spacing and clearance relationships for tram tracks in the carriageway of a public road, both in open sections and at stops or protection islands. The accompanying text gives track-centre spacing, carriage clearances, kerb offsets, curve radii, gradients and camber guidance.
uses: Accommodating tram tracks within public-road traffic space
Providing clearance between tracks, vehicles and fixed objects

fichas.title: Standard widths for special track beds
fichas.summary: Diagrams compare special track-bed arrangements for Types A, B and C, distinguished by the absence of masts, central masts or side masts. Separate diagrams show track-bed widths for general arrangements and for one-sided stops and two-sided stops.

fichas.title: Road-vehicle and tram clearances and track crossings
fichas.summary: Diagrams delineate clearances between road vehicles and trams and illustrate track-bed crossing locations for pedestrians, including arrangements with and without crossing lights. The clearance diagram labels overhead-wire levels and vehicle limitation lines.
